desc: kb:security must not swallow 'antimalware service executable high cpu' — negative lookbehind so 'antimalware' no longer matches the malware security token; those route to kb:performance.

'need to deactivate user' / 'provision user' are onboarding/offboarding lifecycle, not M365 licensing. Remove those two tokens from the kb:m365 rule so the kb:onboarding rule (which already owns them) fires.
